Name: Kitauchi Farm (Ishigaki beef BBQ)
Japanese name: 石垣島きたうち牧場 浜崎本店
Search: 石垣島きたうち牧場 浜崎本店 石垣市浜崎町
Notes: Ranch-run yakiniku. You grill the meat yourselves, which kids enjoy. Book ahead.

Name: Yakiniku Yamamoto
Search: やきにく 山本 石垣市
Notes: The famous Ishigaki beef spot. Reservations fill weeks out.

Name: Ishigaki City Public Market
Search: 石垣市公設市場 石垣市大川
Notes: Easy grazing lunch: fruit, sata-andagi donuts, island snacks.

Name: Paikaji (island izakaya, live sanshin)
Japanese name: 島料理 ぱいかじ 石垣店
Search: 島料理 ぱいかじ 石垣店 石垣市美崎町
Notes: Okinawan home cooking with live folk music. Go early evening with kids.

Name: Pengin Shokudo (home of Ishigaki chili oil)
Search: ペンギン食堂 石垣市大川
Notes: Small diner known for its Ishigaki rāyu chili oil. Jars make good gifts.

Name: MilMil Honpo gelato
Japanese name: ミルミル本舗 本店
Search: ミルミル本舗 本店 石垣市新川
Notes: Dairy-farm gelato on a hill with an ocean view. Ten minutes from the hotel.

Name: ANA InterContinental restaurants
Japanese name: ANAインターコンチネンタル石垣リゾート
Search: ANAインターコンチネンタル石垣リゾート 石垣市真栄里
Notes: The easy dinner when everyone is tired. The buffet has kid options.

Name: Kabira Bay cafés
Search: 川平湾 カフェ 石垣市川平
Notes: A cluster of small cafés by the bay. Pair with the glass-bottom boat.

Name: Takenoko (Yaeyama soba)
Search: 竹の子 八重山郡竹富町竹富
Notes: Classic Yaeyama noodle soup. Lunch stop on Taketomi.

Name: Glass-bottom boat, Kabira Bay
Japanese name: 川平湾 グラスボート
Search: 川平湾 グラスボート 石垣市川平
Notes: 30-minute ride over coral, fish and often turtles. No swimming allowed in the bay.

Name: Ishigaki Yaima Village
Search: 石垣やいま村 石垣市名蔵
Notes: Squirrel-monkey garden, old Okinawan houses, mangrove boardwalk.

Name: Ishigaki Island Limestone Cave
Search: 石垣島鍾乳洞 石垣市石垣
Notes: Lit-up cave walk of about 30 minutes. A good rainy-day pick.

Name: Water-buffalo cart ride
Search: 竹富島 水牛車 八重山郡竹富町竹富
Notes: Slow cart through coral-wall lanes while the driver plays sanshin.

Name: Yubu Island by water buffalo
Search: 由布島 八重山郡竹富町古見
Notes: Ride a buffalo cart across shallow sea to a small garden island with butterflies. A full-day trip.

Name: Ishigaki Astronomical Observatory
Search: 石垣島天文台 石垣市新川
Notes: Weekend telescope nights under very dark skies. Book ahead.

Name: Hamajima "Phantom Island" sandbar tour
Search: 浜島 幻の島 八重山郡竹富町
Notes: A boat drops you on a white sandbar that only appears at low tide. Short and very popular with families. Runs by the tide table. Ask whether you have to step through shallow water to get off the boat.

Name: Banna Park
Search: バンナ公園 石垣市石垣
Notes: Big hillside park with playground areas, slides, lookout towers and forest paths.

Name: Shin'ei Park
Search: 新栄公園 石垣市新栄町
Notes: Town park with playground equipment. Near the port and the Peace Memorial Museum.

Name: Southern Gate Bridge & Hamasaki waterfront
Japanese name: サザンゲートブリッジ
Search: サザンゲートブリッジ 石垣市浜崎町
Notes: Open lawns and a bridge walk at sunset. Room for kids to run.

Name: Maezato Beach (hotel beach)
Search: 真栄里ビーチ 石垣市真栄里
Notes: Calm man-made beach right at the hotel.

Name: Fusaki Beach
Search: フサキビーチ 石垣市新川
Notes: Shallow and calm, with a pier for sunsets. Next to Fusaki Resort.

Name: Sukuji Beach
Search: 底地ビーチ 石垣市川平
Notes: Very shallow and calm. One of the best for small kids.

Name: Yonehara Beach
Search: 米原ビーチ 石垣市桴海
Notes: Beautiful coral-sand beach. At low tide you can see tide pools from the shore. The palm grove is next door.

Name: Kondoi Beach
Search: コンドイビーチ 八重山郡竹富町竹富
Notes: Huge shallow turquoise lagoon. Great for sand play and photos.

Name: Kaiji Beach (star sand)
Search: カイジ浜 八重山郡竹富町竹富
Notes: Search the sand for tiny star-shaped shells. Kids love this. No swimming here.

Name: Sunset Beach (Ishigaki)
Japanese name: サンセットビーチ 石垣島
Search: サンセットビーチ 石垣島 石垣市平久保
Notes: Long, calm, shallow beach on the quiet north side. Showers and rentals. Pair with the lighthouse or Mt. Nosoko.

Name: Mt. Nosoko (Nosoko Māpē)
Search: 野底マーペー 石垣市野底
Notes: About 20 minutes up, with a short scramble at the top. Views of both coasts. Hold hands near the top.

Name: Tamatorizaki Observatory
Search: 玉取崎展望台 石垣市伊原間
Notes: Ten-minute flower-lined path to a panoramic lookout.

Name: Hirakubo-zaki Lighthouse
Search: 平久保崎灯台 石垣市平久保
Notes: Short walk at the northern tip. Wind, a white lighthouse and blue water.

Name: Banna Park trails & lookout
Japanese name: バンナ公園 展望台
Search: バンナ公園 展望台 石垣市石垣
Notes: Shaded forest paths and the best view over Ishigaki town.

Name: Kabira Bay viewpoint
Search: 川平公園 石垣市川平
Notes: The classic postcard view, a few minutes' walk from the parking lot.

Name: Yonehara Palm Grove
Japanese name: 米原のヤエヤマヤシ群落
Search: 米原のヤエヤマヤシ群落 石垣市桴海
Notes: Shaded 15–20 minute boardwalk loop under giant Yaeyama palms, a protected natural monument. Easy for a 5-year-old. Combine with Yonehara Beach.

Name: Uganzaki Lighthouse
Search: 御神崎灯台 石垣市崎枝
Notes: Short walk to a white lighthouse on the cliffs. One of the island's best sunset spots.

Name: Minsah Craft Center (weaving)
Search: みんさー工芸館 石垣市登野城
Notes: Watch Yaeyama minsah weaving and try a short weaving or coaster workshop.

Name: Shiraho Sango Village (WWF coral center)
Search: しらほサンゴ村 石垣市白保
Notes: Small coral education center. Guided reef walks at low tide.

Name: Star-sand & shell workshops
Japanese name: 石垣島 アクセサリー作り 体験
Search: 石垣島 アクセサリー作り 体験 石垣市
Notes: Many shops run 30-minute sessions making star-sand bottles or shell frames. A good rainy-afternoon craft.

Name: Ishigaki-yaki pottery
Search: 石垣焼窯元 石垣市
Notes: Glossy ocean-blue glaze pottery. Gallery and shop.

Name: Euglena Mall (covered arcade)
Search: ユーグレナモール 石垣市大川
Notes: Covered shopping street with souvenirs, snacks and crafts. Rain-proof.

Name: Ishigaki Port Ferry Terminal
Japanese name: 石垣港離島ターミナル
Search: 石垣港離島ターミナル 石垣市美崎町
Notes: Snacks and souvenirs while you wait for the Taketomi or Iriomote ferry.

Name: Ishigaki salt (Ishigaki no Shio)
Search: 石垣の塩 石垣市新川
Notes: Sea-salt maker with a shop. Try the salt ice cream.

Name: San-A Ishigaki City
Search: サンエー石垣シティ 石垣市
Notes: The island's largest store: groceries, clothes, kids' things. There is no big mall on Ishigaki.

Name: MaxValu Ishigaki
Japanese name: マックスバリュ 石垣店
Search: マックスバリュ 石垣店 石垣市
Notes: Supermarket for snacks, fruit and drinks for the hotel room.

Name: Recycle shops in Ishigaki
Japanese name: リサイクルショップ 石垣市
Search: リサイクルショップ 石垣市 石垣市
Notes: A few small recycle shops. Open the map search to see what's near you. Main island options are much better.

Name: Yaeyama Museum
Search: 八重山博物館 石垣市登野城
Notes: Small museum of island boats, festival masks and textiles.

Name: Tōrin-ji Temple & Gongen-dō
Search: 桃林寺・権現堂 石垣市石垣
Notes: Oldest temple in Yaeyama (1614), guarded by two fierce wooden statues. A quick stop in town.

Name: Miyara Dunchi (old noble house)
Search: 宮良殿内 石垣市大川
Notes: 1819 house with a rock garden. A quick, quiet stop.

Name: Tōjin-baka (Chinese tomb)
Search: 唐人墓 石垣市新川
Notes: Colorful 1971 memorial to Chinese laborers who died here in 1852. Striking architecture.

Name: Taketomi village
Search: 竹富島 八重山郡竹富町竹富
Notes: Red-tile roofs, coral walls and sand lanes. Rent bicycles; some have child seats.

Name: Yaeyama Peace Memorial Museum (war malaria)
Search: 八重山平和祈念館 石垣市新栄町
Notes: Covers the forced evacuation into malaria zones in 1945, which killed thousands of islanders. Small and well done.

Name: Night star tour
Japanese name: 石垣島 星空ツアー
Search: 石垣島 星空ツアー 石垣市
Notes: Ishigaki is a designated dark-sky reserve. Early-evening tours are short enough for a 5-year-old.

Name: Iriomote day trip
Search: 西表島 八重山郡竹富町西表
Notes: Jungle river boat up the Urauchi River plus Yubu Island. Book a package tour from Ishigaki port.

Name: Kohama Island
Search: 小浜島 八重山郡竹富町小浜
Notes: Quiet island 25–30 minutes by ferry. Rolling sugarcane fields, Ōdake hill lookout, and a common stop on Hamajima sandbar tours.
